titleEn: Law on the Establishment of Ministry of Interior

articles.en: The Ministry of Interior is hereby established under the Royal Government of Cambodia.

The Ministry of Interior shall have the competence to lead and manage the territorial administration at all levels of the Kingdom of Cambodia, to lead and manage the National Police, to safeguard public order and security, and to protect the safety of the citizens.

The Ministry of Interior shall be led by a Deputy Prime Minister or a Minister, who may be assisted by Secretaries of State and/or Under-Secretaries of State as necessary.
Article 4: The organisational structure and functioning of the Ministry of Interior shall be determined by sub-decree.
Any provisions contrary to this Law shall be considered null and void.
This Law is declared to be urgent. Done at Phnom Penh, 24 January 1996, and respectfully submitted for the Royal signature; First Prime Minister, Second Prime Minister.
